rules.expected: Correct complete objects, conserved stoichiometry, declared states and energy reference. Validate actual atom maps and raw calculation identity before dependent scores. Core comparison: Scheme1 compound1 C23H20BNO3 and compound2 C24H22BNO4, neutral singlets. Compound1 is fixed by CCDC2441197; compound2 adds the para-to-phenoxy methoxy group shown in Scheme1, retaining the 3,5-dimethylphenyl boron substituent. Use mapped X-B-Cipso-Cortho on that aryl branch in both. Primary gas phase and an explicitly identical optical solvent sensitivity. Source SI coordinate labels S5/S6 conflict with Scheme1 identities; their unchecked coordinate assignments are not authorized.
